description:
A series of short-form AI-generated advertisements created for Activia, focused on presenting the brand and its products through clean, engaging, and lifestyle-driven visuals.

I developed the project end-to-end, including concept development, creative direction, visual development, AI production, editing, post-production, and final delivery.

The campaign was created through a fully AI-driven production workflow, with each video designed as a concise digital advertisement tailored for social media.
